training.sampler_rule: original P7 source seed+9999; equal between trainable arms

stress.description: fixed known analytic factual signed-effect family; novel DEV action schedules and observation masks, not independent unfamiliar scientific worlds
stress.initial_regime: old or recent with equal seeded probability
stress.source_generator: np.random.default_rng(seed plus deterministic condition and native-seed offsets), current event random draws independent of selector routing
stress.actions: -1,+1 stochastic based on frozen condition; same trace every arm
stress.history: 8 most recently revealed completed (action, consequence) pairs; none from withheld feedback; no current outcome, regime label, position or future input
stress.default_route: old for trained P7, conventional MLP, P7 zero-history and P6 until identifiable history
stress.trained_inference: two factual predicted counterfactual action outputs per decision, no counterfactual outcomes; route by predicted slope sign, same for P7 and MLP
stress.native_predictor: one shared trained step80 native model with either own saved step80 memory or archived step40 fast memory plus current recurrent/history
stress.prediction_order: all six arms route and predict before sampling current noisy consequence; reveal only if Bernoulli mask true after all predictions
metrics: mature mean squared error after >=8 events since latent switch
immediate MSE after <8 events since latent switch
trainable model training and evaluation wall-time

interpretation: This is a stress-test within a known familiar public synthetic family, not an independent science world.
The same original P7 training generator is reused; train and validation model seeds remain original; no transfer claim.
Biased actions can deprive hand-coded P6 of opposite-sign evidence; sparse revelation reduces available causal feedback for all nonoracle arms.
Oracle evaluator gets latent context, explicitly not an informed baseline.
P7 and MLP get identical data, optimizer update counts, minibatch indices and two route prediction forwards; FLOPs not independently matched.
No live owner, official S26/S27 consumption, new scheduler/controller, FORGE integration, accepted model, or deployment.
